blind.description: A wooden lattice rack designed to hold rolled scrolls. The main body features a diagonal crisscross grid filled with cream-colored parchment scrolls. The flat top surface holds four rolled scrolls tied with dark green ribbon wraps (two on each end) flanking a shiny cylindrical gold scroll tube lying diagonally in the center. The frame is finished in a warm medium-brown wood tone with clean, continuous geometry.
blind.from_above: A horizontal brown rectangle topped with four beige scroll rolls oriented front-to-back with dark green ribbons, flanking a reflective gold tube tilted diagonally in the middle.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 feet tall (roughly half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 feet wide.
